update_message:
What's New in 2.1.7:

👆 Swipe Gesture Controls
• Swipe left/right on mini player to change songs
• Swipe up on mini player to open fullscreen
• Swipe left/right in fullscreen to change songs
• Swipe up in fullscreen to toggle lyrics view
• Swipe down in fullscreen to return to mini player
• 'No lyrics available' popup when swiping up without lyrics

🏷️ Quality Badge Enhancement
• Quality tag (Hi-Res/CD/Lossless) now shown beside title
• Consistent badge placement in both mini and fullscreen players
• Clean, modern badge styling

🔔 Enhanced Media Notification
• New EnhancedMediaNotificationProvider for OEM SystemUI
• Better support for Realme Live Alerts
• Better support for Oppo Aqua Dynamics/ColorOS
• Better support for Samsung One UI Media Panel
• Better support for Xiaomi MIUI Media Controls
• Rich metadata with artwork, duration, album info
• Improved lockscreen and Quick Settings controls

📜 Audio Info System
• Three-section display (SOURCE/PROCESSING/OUTPUT)
• Real-time audio format detection
• Output path indicator (DIRECT/MIXER/OFFLOAD)
• Device detection (Speaker/Bluetooth/USB DAC)

⚡ Performance Improvements
• Fixed home screen scroll animation delay
• Added cacheExtent for smoother list scrolling
• Optimized gesture handling to prevent conflicts
